rules.title: Review heading alignment and containment
rules.action: Discern the intended content boundary and nesting. Record the decision before changing the layout.
rules.done: The intended container is declared; both widths are remeasured; the difference is removed or explicitly accepted with scoped evidence.

rules.title: Review heading-only regions and empty states
rules.action: Decide whether the region needs content, an explicit empty state, a different container or removal.
rules.done: A scoped decision explains the region, and fresh browser readings verify the chosen result.

rules.title: Review skipped heading levels
rules.action: Inspect the section hierarchy and shared template before correcting individual pages.
rules.done: The heading structure is reviewed across affected routes, then remeasured or explicitly accepted with evidence.

rules.title: Discern large spaces below content
rules.action: Check content, sticky narratives, intentional breathing room and min-height. Do not infer waste from distance alone.
rules.done: Purpose is recorded and the chosen change or acceptance is supported by fresh desktop/mobile evidence.

rules.title: Investigate horizontal document overflow
rules.action: Find the overflowing element and distinguish an intentional scrolling surface from unintended page overflow.
rules.done: Both widths verify the resolved layout or an explicit scoped acceptance.

rules.title: Review space after the footer
rules.action: Inspect reservations and footer containment; distinguish purposeful clearance from a leftover reservation.
rules.done: The reservation has a recorded purpose or is removed, with fresh measurements.
